title: Installer, map-builder & routing update
features: Installer & Windows WSL fixes (2.2.6.3): FAT32/exFAT SD-card installs and --update no longer abort on chmod EPERM, and the WSL launcher now verifies venv + ensurepip up front. Head-unit runtime is unchanged from 2.2.6.2.

Faster map building (2.2.6.3): opt-in parallel atlas builds (CLIOPLAY_PIPELINE=1) across Linux, WSL 2 and macOS with deterministic splits and fail-fast cancellation, plus private per-user caching of C++ build helpers.

Eliminated unnecessary U-turn spurs (2.2.6.2): two-way streets now pick the right direction at start and destination, and bounded cleanup bypasses remaining turn-restricted spurs and sharp reversals without breaking needed U-turns.

Simpler routes with fewer turns (2.2.6.2): tight multi-turn side-street zigzags are replaced with straighter legal main roads when added travel time stays small (within 20%, capped at 30 s per leg) with true driving-time ETA.

Close-up Z6–Z9 road alignment & parked snap release (2.2.6.1–2.2.6.2): keeps the vehicle marker and route start centred on roads using existing Z6 geometry, and smoothly eases back to GPS after parking off-road.

Unguided local ML learning: Preferred Nearby POIs, Usual Parking (including habitual car parks with no saved places nearby), POI-named stops/predictions and Usual Route shortcuts learn without an active route.

Unguided commute alerts & predictions: Likely traffic, Frequent slowdown and Cold-weather slowdown cues warn without a route (with dynamic hazard decay/expiry), alongside weekday/weekend weighting and aligned Adaptive Auto-zoom.

Live expandable GPS HUD inside the top clock pill (HH:MM:SS seconds, compass dial, accuracy, satellites, altitude and coordinates) toggled by double-OK or REPEAT, plus Z9–Z4 Auto zoom and tighter Explore diversion framing.
